name: Azure AI
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)

beginner.summary: For developers new to Azure AI. Covers the Azure AI portfolio and responsible AI, Azure OpenAI deployments and prompting, structured outputs and tools, Azure AI Search and RAG, the Language, Vision and Document Intelligence services, Content Safety, monitoring and cost, prompt flow, and a grounded assistant capstone.
prerequisites: An Azure subscription with access to Azure OpenAI
outcomes: Deploy and call Azure OpenAI models
Build grounded RAG with Azure AI Search
Use the Language, Vision and Document Intelligence services
Apply Content Safety, monitoring and cost control

course_outcomes.outcome: Map Azure AI services and apply responsible AI principles
topics: The Azure AI Landscape and Responsible AI

course_outcomes.outcome: Deploy models in Azure OpenAI Service
topics: Azure OpenAI Service and Model Deployments

course_outcomes.outcome: Write prompts for Azure OpenAI models
Return structured outputs and call functions
Index and retrieve content with Azure AI Search
Build retrieval-augmented generation on Azure
Analyse text with Azure AI Language
Extract content from images and documents with Azure AI Vision and Document Intelligence
topics: Azure AI Vision and Document Intelligence

course_outcomes.outcome: Filter harmful content with Content Safety
Monitor usage, cost and quotas
Build flows with Prompt Flow in Azure AI Foundry
topics: Prompt Flow in Azure AI Foundry

course_outcomes.outcome: Deliver a grounded Azure AI assistant
topics: Capstone: A Grounded Azure AI Assistant

days.topic: The Azure AI Landscape and Responsible AI
subtopics: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and Azure AI services
Data privacy and where prompts go
Cost model for tokens and endpoints
Choosing the right service for a task
Setting up a project and connections
days.lab_task: Set up an Azure AI Foundry project, connect an Azure OpenAI resource, and map three business tasks (summarise, classify, extract) to the right Azure AI service with a written reason.
days.deliverable: A Foundry project with a connection and a one-page service-selection note
checks: Create a Foundry project and connection
The project lists a working Azure OpenAI connection
Run a test prompt in the playground
Each task maps to a justified service
objectives: Choose a service for a given task

days.topic: Azure OpenAI Service and Model Deployments
subtopics: Model families: GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o-series, embeddings
API keys versus Entra ID auth
days.lab_task: Deploy a GPT-4o model and an embeddings model, then call both from the Python SDK, handling a rate-limit retry.
days.deliverable: A script that calls a chat and an embeddings deployment with retry handling
checks: Both appear as deployments in the resource
Call the chat deployment from the SDK
The client backs off and retries successfully
objectives: Call chat and embeddings from the SDK

days.lab_task: Turn a vague support prompt into a structured system+few-shot prompt that returns consistent JSON, and show the quality improvement on five test inputs.
days.deliverable: A prompt template and a before/after comparison on five inputs
checks: Add a system prompt and two few-shot examples

days.lab_task: Define a tool schema for an order-status function and a refund function, have the model call them with validated arguments, and require confirmation before the refund.
days.deliverable: A tool-calling script with argument validation and a confirmation gate
checks: Model calls order-status with valid args
A confirmation step runs before execution
The call is rejected, not executed

days.lab_task: Build an Azure AI Search index over a set of PDFs with vector and keyword fields, and run a hybrid query with semantic ranking.
days.deliverable: A populated hybrid index and a working semantic query
checks: Index the documents with vector fields
Results combine keyword and vector matches
Top results improve for a test question
objectives: Create an Azure AI Search index

subtopics: RAG pattern and when to use it
days.lab_task: Build a RAG assistant over the indexed PDFs that answers with citations and refuses when the answer is not in the sources.
days.deliverable: A RAG assistant that cites sources and declines unsupported questions
checks: The answer is correct and cites a source
The assistant declines rather than inventing
Chunks are relevant to the question
objectives: Build a RAG pipeline on Azure

subtopics: Named entity recognition and PII detection
days.lab_task: Use Azure AI Language to redact PII from support tickets and classify them by issue type with a custom classifier.
days.deliverable: A pipeline that redacts PII and classifies tickets
checks: Emails and phone numbers are redacted
Each ticket gets an issue type
Labels match a manual review on a sample
objectives: Classify text with a custom model

days.topic: Azure AI Vision and Document Intelligence
subtopics: Document Intelligence prebuilt models (invoice, receipt, ID)
days.lab_task: Extract line items and totals from a set of invoices with Document Intelligence, route low-confidence fields to a review queue, and write the results to a table.
days.deliverable: An invoice-extraction pipeline with a confidence-based review queue
checks: Extract fields from a clean invoice
Totals and line items are correct
Low-confidence fields are flagged for review
Structured rows land in the table

days.lab_task: Wrap the RAG assistant with Content Safety so unsafe inputs and outputs are blocked, and add a prompt shield against a jailbreak attempt.
days.deliverable: A safety-wrapped assistant with evidence it blocks unsafe and jailbreak inputs
checks: It is blocked before reaching the model
objectives: Apply Content Safety to inputs and outputs

days.lab_task: Instrument the assistant to log token usage and latency to Azure Monitor, build a usage dashboard, and set a budget alert.
days.deliverable: A usage dashboard and a working budget alert
checks: Set and trip a budget alert
An alert fires at the threshold
objectives: Control cost with budgets and quotas

days.topic: Prompt Flow in Azure AI Foundry
subtopics: Connecting data and tools in a flow
Deploying a flow as an endpoint
days.lab_task: Rebuild the RAG assistant as a prompt flow with two prompt variants, run it over a test dataset, and compare the variants with an evaluation flow.
days.deliverable: A prompt flow with two variants and an evaluation comparison
checks: Build the flow with retrieve and generate nodes
The flow runs end to end
Run a batch over the dataset
One variant scores higher on groundedness

days.topic: Capstone: A Grounded Azure AI Assistant
days.lab_task: Deliver a grounded assistant: Azure AI Search retrieval, Azure OpenAI generation with citations, Content Safety guardrails, and Azure Monitor logging, demonstrated on real questions.
days.deliverable: A working grounded assistant with safety, monitoring and a demo
objectives: Assemble a grounded Azure AI assistant

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built with Azure OpenAI. Covers quotas and throughput, advanced prompting and tools, deep Azure AI Search, production RAG, evaluation and groundedness, fine-tuning, Azure ML pipelines and MLOps, content safety and governance, security and private networking, agents, multimodal and speech, and a governed application capstone.
prerequisites: Has called Azure OpenAI from code
Comfortable with RAG and prompting basics
Familiar with Azure resources and the CLI
outcomes: Build production RAG and agents on Azure
Operate Azure ML pipelines and MLOps
Secure and govern Azure AI workloads

course_outcomes.outcome: Plan Azure OpenAI deployments, quotas and throughput
topics: Azure OpenAI Deployments, Quotas and Throughput

course_outcomes.outcome: Apply advanced prompting and function calling
Run vector and hybrid search in Azure AI Search
topics: Azure AI Search: Vector and Hybrid at Depth

course_outcomes.outcome: Build production RAG pipelines
Evaluate answers for groundedness
Fine-tune Azure OpenAI models
Build Azure Machine Learning pipelines
Apply MLOps practices on Azure
Govern AI content with Content Safety
topics: Content Safety and Governance at Depth

course_outcomes.outcome: Secure AI services with private networking
Build agents that use tools
Add multimodal and speech features
Deliver a governed Azure AI application
topics: Capstone: A Governed Azure AI Application

days.topic: Azure OpenAI Deployments, Quotas and Throughput
subtopics: Cost per token versus PTU economics
days.lab_task: Compare standard and provisioned throughput for a workload: measure latency and cost per 1,000 requests, and recommend a deployment model.
days.deliverable: A measured comparison of standard vs PTU with a recommendation
checks: Latency and cost per 1k are recorded
Estimate PTU for the same load
A capacity and cost estimate is produced
The choice is justified by cost and latency

days.lab_task: Convert a single large prompt into a chain (classify, retrieve, answer, verify) with tools, and defend it against a prompt-injection payload.
days.deliverable: A prompt chain with tools that resists an injection attempt
checks: Each step does one job and the chain answers
Verify output with a check step
Bad outputs are caught and retried

days.topic: Azure AI Search: Vector and Hybrid at Depth
days.lab_task: Tune a retrieval index: test two chunking strategies and hybrid versus vector-only, and measure retrieval relevance on a labelled question set.
days.deliverable: A tuned index with a relevance comparison across strategies
checks: Relevance scores are measured on the question set
A user sees only permitted documents

days.lab_task: Harden the RAG pipeline with query rewriting, a groundedness check and a fallback when retrieval is weak, and trace each step's latency.
days.deliverable: A production RAG pipeline with grounding checks, fallback and tracing
checks: Ungrounded answers are refused or flagged
Each step's time is visible and within budget

subtopics: Groundedness, relevance, coherence and fluency metrics
days.lab_task: Build an evaluation set for the assistant, run groundedness and relevance metrics with the Azure AI evaluation SDK, and set a quality gate that blocks a bad prompt change.
days.deliverable: An evaluation harness with a quality gate
checks: The quality gate fails the change

subtopics: When to fine-tune versus RAG or prompting
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a model for a classification style the base model handles poorly, compare it to a few-shot baseline, and deploy it only if it wins.
days.deliverable: A fine-tuned model with a baseline comparison and a deploy decision
checks: Accuracy versus the few-shot baseline is measured
Deploy only if the fine-tune wins, with a cost note

days.lab_task: Build an Azure ML pipeline that prepares data, trains a model and registers it, then deploy the registered model to a managed online endpoint.
days.deliverable: An Azure ML pipeline and a deployed managed endpoint
checks: A model is trained and registered
It is reproducible with tracked inputs

subtopics: CI/CD for models with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
Infrastructure as code for Azure ML
days.lab_task: Create a CI/CD workflow that evaluates a new model, promotes it through a gate, deploys with a canary and can roll back.
days.deliverable: A model CI/CD workflow with an evaluation gate, canary and rollback
checks: Trigger the workflow on a model change
Only models meeting the bar deploy
Traffic returns to the previous model

days.topic: Content Safety and Governance at Depth
subtopics: Policy per application and per role
days.lab_task: Implement a governance layer: per-application safety policies, audit logging of all prompts and completions, and an incident-review query.
days.deliverable: A governance layer with per-app policies and an audit/incident report
checks: Each app enforces its own thresholds
The incident is traced end to end

subtopics: Entra ID authentication and managed identities
Key management and secrets in Key Vault
days.lab_task: Lock down the Azure OpenAI resource: managed-identity auth, a private endpoint with public access disabled, and secrets in Key Vault, then prove access only works from the VNet.
days.deliverable: A privately networked, identity-authenticated AI resource
checks: Key-based access is no longer required
Add a private endpoint and disable public access
Public calls fail; VNet calls succeed

days.lab_task: Build an agent that answers account questions using a retrieval tool and an order-API tool, with a human approval step before any write.
days.deliverable: A tool-using agent with grounded answers and an approval gate
checks: Agent answers using the retrieval tool
Runaway loops are bounded by a step limit

subtopics: Azure AI Speech: speech-to-text and text-to-speech
days.lab_task: Build a flow that transcribes a support call with Azure AI Speech, summarises it with GPT-4o, and extracts action items.
days.deliverable: A speech-to-summary pipeline with extracted action items
checks: Summary and action items are accurate

days.topic: Capstone: A Governed Azure AI Application
days.lab_task: Deliver a governed Azure AI application: grounded RAG or agent, Content Safety, Entra ID auth with a private endpoint, evaluation gate and monitoring, released only after passing quality and safety checks.
days.deliverable: A governed, monitored Azure AI application with evaluation evidence
checks: Groundedness and relevance meet the bar
Access requires identity and the VNet
Usage, latency and spend are tracked
objectives: Assemble a governed Azure AI app

advanced.summary: For AI engineers and architects. Covers enterprise RAG architecture, multi-agent orchestration, advanced evaluation and red-teaming, fine-tuning/distillation, Azure ML at scale, responsible-AI governance, cost and throughput engineering, LLMOps, observability and drift, migration strategy, AI security architecture, and a platform-review capstone.
prerequisites: One or more years building AI applications
Comfortable with RAG, agents, evaluation and Azure ML
Experience with CI/CD and cloud security
outcomes: Architect enterprise RAG and multi-agent systems
Run evaluation, red-teaming and responsible-AI governance
Lead AI security and platform reviews

course_outcomes.outcome: Design an enterprise RAG architecture
Orchestrate multiple agents
Evaluate and red-team AI systems
Fine-tune, distil and optimise models
Run Azure Machine Learning at scale
Run a responsible AI and governance programme
Optimise AI cost and engineer throughput
Deliver AI changes continuously with LLMOps
Monitor drift and act on user feedback
Plan migration and AI platform strategy
Design security architecture for AI systems
Review an Azure AI platform

subtopics: Access control and security trimming at scale
Latency and cost budgeting across the stack
days.lab_task: Design an enterprise RAG architecture for multiple data sources and tenants with security trimming, and prove isolation and a latency budget on a sample.
days.deliverable: An enterprise RAG architecture with isolation and latency evidence
checks: The right source answers each query type
A tenant never sees another tenant's data
The stack meets the latency budget
objectives: Budget latency and cost across the stack

days.lab_task: Build a planner-worker-critic agent system for a research task, with per-agent tool permissions, a critic that rejects ungrounded claims, and a global step budget.
days.deliverable: A multi-agent system with permissions, a critic and a step budget
checks: The task completes with a grounded result
The critic rejects an ungrounded claim
The claim is revised or dropped
objectives: Control cost and evaluate agent systems

days.lab_task: Build a red-team and evaluation suite that scores safety, groundedness and bias, and wire it as a release gate with a published scorecard.
days.deliverable: A red-team/evaluation suite acting as a release gate with a scorecard
checks: Jailbreaks and unsafe outputs are detected
The gate stops a model that fails the bar
objectives: Evaluate safety and groundedness at scale

subtopics: Governance of training data and lineage
days.lab_task: Distill a cheaper fine-tuned model from a strong teacher for a narrow task, prove it matches quality at lower cost, and set a retraining trigger.
days.deliverable: A distilled model with a quality/cost comparison and a retraining plan
checks: Create distillation data from the teacher
A clean labelled set is produced
Quality matches the teacher within tolerance at lower cost
Drift or quality drop triggers retraining

subtopics: Cost optimisation for training and serving
days.lab_task: Run a distributed training job on a GPU cluster and deploy the result to an autoscaling managed endpoint, with a load test proving autoscale and a cost estimate.
days.deliverable: A distributed training run and an autoscaling endpoint with a load test
checks: The job scales across the cluster
objectives: Train at scale on Azure ML

subtopics: Responsible AI standard and impact assessments
Regulatory landscape (EU AI Act and others)
days.lab_task: Stand up a responsible-AI governance process: an impact assessment for one use case, a risk register, audit logging and an oversight workflow.
days.deliverable: A responsible-AI governance pack for one use case

days.lab_task: Cut the cost of a high-volume feature: add semantic caching, route easy requests to a cheaper model, and compress prompts, then prove the savings and unchanged quality.
days.deliverable: Three implemented savings with measured cost and quality impact
checks: Easy requests use the cheaper model

subtopics: CI/CD for prompts, flows and models
days.lab_task: Build an LLMOps pipeline that versions prompts and flows, runs evaluation on every change, deploys a shadow version and promotes it only after it beats production.
days.deliverable: An LLMOps pipeline with evaluation, shadow deploy and promotion
checks: It runs on live traffic without serving users
Only a better version is promoted

subtopics: Quality and safety metrics in production
Closing the loop to evaluation sets
days.lab_task: Instrument the application for end-to-end tracing, capture user feedback, detect a groundedness regression and feed failing cases back into the evaluation set.
days.deliverable: An observability setup that detects regression and improves the eval set
checks: Retrieval, prompt and tools are visible
An alert fires on the regression
The eval set grows from production misses
objectives: Trace AI systems end to end

subtopics: Migrating from other LLM providers to Azure OpenAI
days.lab_task: Plan a migration of an existing assistant to Azure OpenAI behind a provider-independent abstraction, run it in parallel, and reconcile quality before cutover.
days.deliverable: A migration plan with a parallel run and quality reconciliation
checks: Switching providers is a config change
Outputs are compared against the incumbent
Quality matches and a cutover/rollback plan exists

subtopics: Prompt injection and data exfiltration defences
days.lab_task: Threat-model the AI application, implement defences for the top three risks (injection, exfiltration, access), and validate them with targeted tests.
days.deliverable: A threat model with implemented, tested defences for the top risks
checks: Top risks are identified and ranked
Attacks in the test set are blocked
Only authorised identities and networks reach the app

subtopics: Reviewing an AI workload against best practice
Quality, safety, security, cost and reliability
days.lab_task: Review a provided Azure AI workload across quality, safety, security, cost and reliability, and present prioritised findings with a remediation roadmap.
days.deliverable: An AI platform-review report with prioritised findings and a roadmap
checks: Every finding cites a metric, log or test
Items are ranked by impact and effort
Trade-offs and next steps are clear
objectives: Review an AI workload against best practice
